text: Grupo Visabeira consolidates its accounts in the entity NCFGest, SA, its majority shareholder, which is held 100% by Fernando Campos Nunes; the notes also state the ultimate majority shareholder held 98.57% of Grupo Visabeira indirectly at the end of 2024 and 2025.
short: Fernando Campos Nunes holds 98.57% of Grupo Visabeira via NCFGest.

source.name: Grupo Visabeira, Relatório & Contas 2025 (p. 89)
source.quote: O Grupo Visabeira consolida as suas contas na entidade NCFGest, SA, acionista maioritária e detida a 100% por Fernando Campos Nunes.
source.note: 10.9 MB PDF: check_sources.py reads only the first 8 MB. Read in full with pypdf (strict=False) on 2026-09-28: the quote is on PDF page 89; note 31.1 (PDF page 126) gives the 98.57% held indirectly at the end of 2024 and 2025.

additionalSources.name: Martifer SGPS: Martifer Group informs about qualified holdings (6 August 2025)
additionalSources.quote: NCFGEST, S.A., which holds 98.57% of the share capital and voting rights of Grupo Visabeira, S.A.; and c) to Fernando Campos Nunes, the company referred to in b) being wholly owned by this individual shareholder.
